data.title: The first student is never marked present
story: The attendance summary is always one short when the first student on the list is present. "P" means present, "A" means absent.
Add print(i) inside the loop to see which positions are checked.

explanation: range(1, len(attendance)) starts at position 1, but the first student is at position 0, so they are never checked. range(len(attendance)) starts at 0 and checks every student.
hints: Print i in every round. Which number shows up first?
Lists in Python start at position 0. Is position 0 checked?
